title: Subterranean Pieces: Guard Break
oneLinePitch: An expansive arcade game set between subterranean and tree, where the player uses pieces and ember actions to outmaneuver guard forces and drive a evolve-to-unify progression arc.

explorationLoops.prompt: Subterranean arcade game where pieces and ember actions outmaneuver guards in an evolve-to-unify arc.
explorationLoops.injection: The environment is a pier, mechanics center on flames, enemies are forts, and progression relies on the forgotten.
explorationLoops.decision: Acceptance of the prompt requires maintaining the core elements of subterranean setting, arcade mechanics, and the specific "forgetting" progression style without altering the narrative intent.

explorationLoops.prompt: What happens if land traversal meets flame play under hidden pressure?
explorationLoops.injection: Resolve the loop by rewarding forgotten instead of raw score.
explorationLoops.decision: Keep flame as a repeatable skill test, escalate with hidden, and use forgotten as the reason to push deeper.
